name: Guideline mau (demo)

sections.title: 1. Pham vi
sections.body: Tai lieu gan nhan giao thong 2D cho du an GreenSM.

sections.title: 2. Quy tac chung
sections.body: Box om sat vat. Vat bi che van dong box toan bo (amodal).

sections.title: 3.1 O to (car)
sections.body: Moi o to dong box om sat ca banh xe. Xe tai (truck) va xe buyt (bus) gan nhan rieng.

sections.title: 3.2 Xe GreenSM
sections.body: Taxi mau xanh ngoc cua GreenSM gan nhan GreenSM, khong gan car.

sections.title: 3.3 Xe may (motorcycle)
sections.body: Xe may va nguoi lai: nguoi lai co box person rieng.

sections.title: 3.4 Nguoi (person)
sections.body: Nguoi di bo va nguoi lai xe deu gan person.
